💡 Voice-Clone-Studio | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified and user-friendly web interface for performing a wide range of voice cloning, voice design, and multi-speaker conversation generation tasks by integrating multiple advanced AI voice engines.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-model voice cloning with engines like Qwen3-TTS, VibeVoice, LuxTTS, Chatterbox, and Fish Speech • Automatic transcription support via Whisper, VibeVoice-ASR, and Qwen3-ASR
📖 Summary: Voice Clone Studio is a modular, Gradio-based web UI for advanced voice manipulation tasks. It integrates multiple state-of-the-art engines for voice cloning, voice conversion, multi-speaker conversation generation, and sound effect creation, offering a unified interface for various voice AI technologies.
